objective: Run the W72 remote smoke command pack against the real hosted websiteResolverServiceV1 endpoint.
honestReadinessPosition: W72 produced the remote deployment readiness gate and command pack.
W73 requires a real remote staging URL and resolver token.
No IDB_REMOTE_RESOLVER_* environment variables are configured in this workspace.
Remote smoke results must not be fabricated from local or synthetic harnesses.
remoteSmokeRequiredResults: Remote /health returns writeAuthority none, suiteScriptInvocation false, nllmAdvisoryOnly true.
Approved CORS preflight passes without wildcard CORS.
Blocked CORS preflight fails without echoing blocked origin.
Second eligible request returns cacheHit true.
Approved live-site smoke has zero false-confident-wrong and zero unsupported claims.
Blocked, thin, unavailable, and timeout remain insufficient evidence with no lane candidates.

goIf: W73 remote smoke executes against a real hosted URL.
Approved live-site smoke has zero false-confident-wrong.
Rollback switch is documented and tested.
noGoIf: CORS allows wildcard or blocked origin.
Resolver accepts write-shaped or NetSuite-auth-shaped payload.
Blocked, thin, unavailable, or timeout produces a confident lane.
